properties.title: iRIC: An Open-Source Platform for River and Flood Simulation
properties.description:
iRIC is a free and open-source software platform for river flow, flood inundation, sediment transport, and rainfall-runoff simulation. It provides a common graphical interface for a wide range of numerical models developed by researchers and engineers.

This sponsor session briefly introduces the iRIC platform, its international user and developer community, and recent developments in river and flood simulation. We also invite researchers, engineers, developers, educators, and organizations to visit our booth and explore opportunities for collaboration.

River and flood simulation software is often developed independently for individual research projects, making it difficult for engineers, researchers, students, and public agencies to access and use advanced numerical models.

iRIC addresses this challenge by providing a common, free and open-source software environment for numerical simulation in river engineering and related fields. The platform supports multiple solvers for river flow, flood inundation, sediment transport, riverbed evolution, rainfall-runoff processes, and other water-related phenomena.

Through a unified graphical user interface, users can prepare input data, generate computational grids, run simulations, visualize results, and export outputs without having to build an entire modelling environment from scratch.

In this five-minute sponsor presentation, we will introduce:

* the concept and structure of the iRIC platform;
* examples of river and flood simulation;
* the international iRIC user and developer community;
* opportunities for software development, research, education, and practical collaboration.

Participants interested in open-source hydraulic modelling, disaster risk reduction, environmental simulation, or scientific software development are warmly invited to visit the iRIC-UC booth.
